about_the_game:
A memory passed into this hand, to be carried forward.

The album will include all 16 in-game BGM tracks featured in the main story, “The People and the World.” The music is composed by Keiichi Okabe, Shotaro Seo, and Kuniyuki Takahashi of the music production studio MONACA. We hope you enjoy the ephemeral yet beautiful melodies that weave together the final story of NieR Re[in]carnation.

*NieR Re[in]carnation was the first mobile title in the NieR series, released in February 2021. (The service has since been discontinued.)
